item.title: Proton offers trade-in incentives tied to govt matching grant
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Proton Holdings Bhd is offering trade-in incentives across all its current models for customers to trade-in vehicles that are 20 years or older.

item.title: Pan Gon keeps Selangor grounded after win
item.description: Selangor head coach Kim Pan Gon dismissed talk of early success after a 2-0 win over Vietnam’s Cong An Ha Noi that lifted the Red Giants to the top of Group A of the Asean Club Championship.

item.title: Pakistan becomes latest Asian country to introduce checks for deadly Nipah virus
item.description: LAHORE: Authorities in Pakistan have ordered enhanced screening of people entering the country for signs of infections of the deadly Nipah virus after India confirmed two cases, adding to the number of Asian countries stepping up controls.

item.title: Rybakina battles into Australian Open final against Sabalenka
item.description: MELBOURNE: Elena Rybakina battled past Jessica Pegula into the Australian Open final on Thursday with the fifth seed setting up a repeat of her 2023 title match against Aryna Sabalenka.

item.title: Umpire call fired up Sabalenka in politically charged Melbourne clash
item.description: MELBOURNE: Belarusian Aryna Sabalenka said that an umpire call against her for grunting helped fire her to victory over Ukraine’s Elina Svitolina on Thursday in a politically charged Australian Open semi-final.

item.title: Iran vows 'crushing response', EU targets Revolutionary Guards
item.description: PARIS: Iran on Thursday vowed a “crushing response” to any attack after US President Donald Trump warned time was running out for a nuclear deal, and as the European Union looks to declare the Revolutionary Guards a terrorist organisation.

item.title: No handshake as Sabalenka sets up repeat of 2023 Melbourne final
item.description: MELBOURNE: Belarusian world number one Aryna Sabalenka crushed Ukraine’s Elina Svitolina in a politically charged Australian Open semi-final on Thursday and faces Elena Rybakina for a third Melbourne title.

item.title: 150 MPs wind up debate on motion of thanks for royal address
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A total of 150 members of parliament have wound up the debate on the motion of thanks for the Royal Address in the Dewan Rakyat, which commenced on Jan 20.
